ko.content: 인사 노래 + 이달의 노래

en.content: Greeting Song + Song of the Month

ko.content: 테마 활동 (아래 커리큘럼 참고)

en.content: Theme activity (see curriculum below)

ko.content: Goodbye Song + 한 줄 복습

en.content: Goodbye Song + One-line review

songs.song: If You're Happy and You Know It
You've Got a Friend in Me

ko.label: 5세반
ko.name: 5세반
ko.desc: 짧은 집중력(10~15분), 모방 중심, 단어·짧은 구문 수준, 신체 활동 선호

en.label: Age 5 Class
en.name: Age 5 Class
en.desc: Short attention span (10–15 min), imitation-based, word/short phrase level, prefers physical activity

ko.label: 6세반
ko.name: 6세반
ko.desc: 집중력 향상(15~25분), 간단한 문장 말하기 가능, 규칙 있는 게임 가능, 역할극 가능

en.label: Age 6 Class
en.name: Age 6 Class
en.desc: Improved attention span (15–25 min), can speak simple sentences, can play games with rules, role-play possible

ko.label: 7세반
ko.name: 7세반
ko.desc: 집중력 25분 이상, 문장 말하기·쓰기 가능, 논리적 사고 발달, 토론·발표 가능

en.label: Age 7 Class
en.name: Age 7 Class
en.desc: Attention span 25+ min, can speak/write sentences, developing logical thinking, can debate and present

tips.ko: 오프닝은 항상 같은 인사 노래로 시작 → 아이들이 심리적으로 안정됩니다.
tips.en: Opening always starts with the same greeting song → Children feel psychologically settled.

tips.ko: 이달의 노래는 4주 동안 매 수업 반복. 이전 달 노래도 가끔 리뷰.
tips.en: Song of the Month is repeated every class for 4 weeks. Previous month's song occasionally reviewed.

tips.ko: 5세반: 틀려도 박수 먼저! 단어 하나만 말해도 성공으로 인정.
tips.en: Age 5: Applause first even if wrong! Even one word counts as success.

tips.ko: 6세반: 문장 말하기 목표. 발표 기회 골고루, 게임엔 규칙 설명 필수.
tips.en: Age 6: Aim for full sentences. Equal speaking opportunities; game rules must be explained.

tips.ko: 7세반: 이유 말하기(because), 비교(more/less), 의견 표현(I think) 집중 연습.
tips.en: Age 7: Focus on giving reasons (because), comparing (more/less), expressing opinions (I think).

tips.ko: 포트폴리오(만든 작품 모음)를 학기 말에 학부모 공유 → 성장 실감.
tips.en: Share portfolios with parents at semester end → Students feel real growth.

tips.ko: 월 1회 'Star of the Week' → 잘한 친구 칭찬 & 동기 부여.
tips.en: Monthly 'Star of the Week' → Praise standout students & motivate the class.

en.title: Age 5 Circle Time Activities (3–4 years / 24 activities)

ko.name: Name Ball Toss
ko.content: 공을 굴리며 "My name is ___!" 말하기. 받은 친구가 다음 사람에게 넘기기.
ko.tips: 처음엔 선생님이 먼저 시범. 이름을 크게 말한 뒤 천천히 굴리기. 틀려도 OK, 박수 먼저!

en.name: Name Ball Toss
en.content: Roll a ball and say "My name is ___!" The friend who catches it passes it to the next person.
en.tips: Teacher demonstrates first. Say name loudly then roll slowly. It's OK to be wrong — applause first!

ko.name: Who's Missing?
ko.content: 한 명 숨기고 "Who is missing?" 맞히기. "Where is ___?" 연습.
ko.tips: 눈을 가리는 동안 노래 불러 집중 유도. 찾으면 함께 환호!

en.name: Who's Missing?
en.content: Hide one child and guess "Who is missing?" Practice "Where is ___?"
en.tips: Sing a song while eyes are covered to maintain focus. Cheer together when found!

ko.name: Simon Says
ko.content: "Simon says touch your nose!" 신체 반응 게임.
ko.tips: 처음엔 탈락 없이 즐기기. 속도를 점점 빠르게 하면 웃음 폭발!

en.name: Simon Says
en.content: "Simon says touch your nose!" Physical response game.
en.tips: Start without elimination. Gradually speed up for big laughs!

ko.name: Body Stamp & Label
ko.content: 전신 종이에 도장 찍고 신체 단어 스티커 붙이기.
ko.tips: 아이가 종이에 누워 선생님이 외곽선 그려주기. 완성 후 "This is my nose!" 발표.

en.name: Body Stamp & Label
en.content: Stamp on full-body paper and attach body word stickers.
en.tips: Child lies on paper while teacher traces outline. After completing, present "This is my nose!"

ko.name: Emotion Freeze Dance
ko.content: 음악 멈추면 감정 카드 보고 표정 짓기.
ko.tips: 카드 없이 선생님 표정만 보고 따라 해도 OK. 과장된 표정이 핵심!

en.name: Emotion Freeze Dance
en.content: When music stops, look at emotion card and make that expression.
en.tips: Teacher's expressions alone work too. Exaggerated expressions are key!

ko.name: Feeling Faces Craft
ko.content: 오늘 기분 얼굴 그리기 + "I feel happy/sad!" 말하기.
ko.tips: "How do you feel today?" 루틴화. 매주 차트에 스티커 붙이기.

en.name: Feeling Faces Craft
en.content: Draw today's mood face + say "I feel happy/sad!"
en.tips: Routine "How do you feel today?" Add stickers to chart each week.

ko.name: Vehicle Parade
ko.content: 버스/자동차/기차 흉내내며 교실 한 바퀴 행진.
ko.tips: 각 탈것 소리도 함께! "Beep beep!" "Choo choo!" 과장해서 유도.

en.name: Vehicle Parade
en.content: March around the classroom imitating a bus/car/train.
en.tips: Include vehicle sounds! "Beep beep!" "Choo choo!" Encourage exaggeration.

ko.name: Transportation Sort
ko.content: 땅/바다/하늘 탈것 그림 카드를 매트에 분류하기.
ko.tips: "Does it fly? Does it swim?" 질문으로 사고 유도. 오답도 함께 생각하기.

en.name: Transportation Sort
en.content: Sort picture cards of land/sea/sky vehicles onto a mat.
en.props: 3 sets of picture cards, sorting mat
en.tips: Guide thinking with "Does it fly? Does it swim?" Think through wrong answers together.

ko.name: Ocean Movement Game
ko.content: 물고기/게/해파리처럼 몸으로 표현하며 움직이기.
ko.tips: 선생님이 먼저 과장해서 시범. 배경 음악으로 파도 소리 틀어주기.

en.name: Ocean Movement Game
en.content: Move and express like a fish/crab/jellyfish.
en.tips: Teacher exaggerates to demonstrate first. Play wave sounds in the background.

ko.name: Sea Animal Bag
ko.content: 촉감 백에서 바다 동물 피규어 꺼내며 이름 말하기.
ko.tips: 꺼내기 전 "Is it big? Is it soft?" 힌트 주기. 꺼낸 후 다 같이 이름 외치기.

en.name: Sea Animal Bag
en.content: Pull sea animal figures from a tactile bag and say their names.
en.tips: Before pulling out: "Is it big? Is it soft?" Hint first. Then everyone shouts the name together.

ko.name: Animal Sound Guessing
ko.content: 소리 듣고 동물 맞히기 "It's a ___!"
ko.tips: 틀려도 웃으며 넘기기. 맞히면 그 동물 소리 다 같이 내보기.

en.name: Animal Sound Guessing
en.content: Listen to sounds and guess the animal "It's a ___!"
en.tips: Laugh off wrong answers. If correct, everyone makes that animal sound together.

ko.name: Farm Animal Headbands
ko.content: 동물 머리띠 쓰고 소리+움직임 함께 표현.
ko.tips: 친구 머리띠 보고 이름 맞히기. "You are a cow! Moo!"

en.name: Farm Animal Headbands
en.content: Wear animal headbands and express sounds + movements.
en.tips: Look at a friend's headband and guess. "You are a cow! Moo!"

ko.name: Number Hopscotch
ko.content: 숫자 바닥 판 위로 점프하며 1~10 세기.
ko.tips: 거꾸로(10→1) 도전도 추가. 팀으로 릴레이 하면 더 신남!

en.name: Number Hopscotch
en.content: Jump on numbered floor tiles while counting 1–10.
en.tips: Add reverse (10→1) challenge. Relay race format makes it even more exciting!

ko.name: Count & Drop
ko.content: 컵에 블록 넣으며 1~10 세기.
ko.tips: "One, two, three..." 함께 세기. 다 넣으면 컵을 흔들며 "Ten!"

en.name: Count & Drop
en.content: Count 1–10 while placing blocks in a cup.
en.tips: Count together "One, two, three..." Shake the cup and say "Ten!" when done.

ko.name: Halloween Dress-Up
ko.content: 마녀/유령/호박 소품 입어보며 단어 익히기.
ko.tips: 거울 앞에서 "I am a witch!" 크게 말하기. 친구가 맞히는 게임도 추가.

en.name: Halloween Dress-Up
en.content: Try on witch/ghost/pumpkin props to learn vocabulary.
en.tips: In front of mirror: "I am a witch!" say it loudly. Add a guessing game with friends.

ko.name: Spooky Color Mix
ko.content: 주황+검정 물감 섞기 + "orange! black!" 색깔 말하기.
ko.tips: 손가락으로 섞어도 OK. "Spooky! Scary!" 표현 추가로 분위기 up.

en.name: Spooky Color Mix
en.content: Mix orange + black paint + say "orange! black!"
en.tips: Finger mixing is OK. Add "Spooky! Scary!" expressions for atmosphere.

ko.name: Leaf Sorting
ko.content: 낙엽을 색깔/크기별로 분류 + "big/small, red/yellow" 말하기.
ko.tips: 실제 낙엽이면 질감도 말하기 "It's rough!" 감각 어휘 확장.

en.name: Leaf Sorting
en.content: Sort fallen leaves by color/size + say "big/small, red/yellow"
en.tips: With real leaves, describe texture too "It's rough!" Expand sensory vocabulary.

ko.name: Nature Walk Words
ko.content: 교실 밖 짧은 산책 + 보이는 것 영어로 말하기.
ko.tips: 포인트 앤 세이! "I see a tree!" 선생님이 먼저, 아이가 따라. 돌아와서 그림으로 기록.

en.name: Nature Walk Words
en.content: Short walk outside + name what you see in English.
en.tips: Point and say! "I see a tree!" Teacher first, then students repeat. Draw pictures when back inside.

ko.name: Wrap the Gift
ko.content: 선물 포장 흉내내며 색깔/크기 말하기.
ko.tips: "Big or small? What color?" 말하게 하기. 리본 붙이며 "Ta-da!" 마무리.

en.name: Wrap the Gift
en.content: Pretend to wrap gifts while saying color/size.
en.tips: "Big or small? What color?" Let them speak. Finish with "Ta-da!" when attaching ribbon.

ko.name: Holiday Crafts & Sing
ko.content: 크리스마스 장식 만들며 노래 부르기.
ko.tips: 만들기 중 노래 반복 재생. 완성 후 "This is my star!" 들고 발표.

en.name: Holiday Crafts & Sing
en.content: Make Christmas decorations while singing.
en.tips: Repeat song during crafting. After completing: "This is my star!" hold and present.

ko.name: Letter Sound Parade
ko.content: A~Z 카드 들고 행진하며 소리 외치기.
ko.tips: "A says /a/!" 구호처럼 크게. 사진 찍어 교실에 붙이면 복습 효과.

en.name: Letter Sound Parade
en.content: March holding A–Z cards while shouting sounds.
en.tips: "A says /a/!" like a chant, say it loudly. Post photos in classroom for ongoing review.

ko.name: Sound Basket
ko.content: 바구니에서 물건 꺼내며 첫 글자 소리 말하기.
ko.tips: "What sound does it start with?" 기다리기. 틀리면 다 같이 힌트!

en.name: Sound Basket
en.content: Pull items from a basket and say the first letter sound.
en.tips: "What sound does it start with?" Wait patiently. If wrong, everyone gives a hint!

ko.name: My Favorite Color Book
ko.content: 좋아하는 색 골라 미니북 완성 + "My favorite color is ___" 발표.
ko.tips: 발표 전 연습 시간 1분. 친구 책 보며 "Me too!" 반응 유도.

en.name: My Favorite Color Book
en.content: Choose a favorite color and complete a mini-book + present "My favorite color is ___"
en.tips: 1 minute practice before presenting. Encourage "Me too!" responses to classmates' books.

ko.name: Friends Circle Celebration
ko.content: 친구 이름 부르며 칭찬 스티커 붙여주기 + 노래.
ko.tips: "You are amazing!" 등 칭찬 문장 미리 연습. 왕관 쓰고 찍은 사진 학부모 공유.

en.name: Friends Circle Celebration
en.content: Call out friends' names, attach praise stickers + sing.
en.tips: Pre-practice praise sentences like "You are amazing!" Share crown photos with parents.

en.title: Age 6 Circle Time Activities (4–5 years / 24 activities)

ko.name: All About Me Poster
ko.content: 자기 소개 포스터 만들고 "My name is ___, I am ___ years old, I like ___" 발표.
ko.tips: 발표 전 파트너와 연습 1번. 발표 후 교실에 전시.

en.name: All About Me Poster
en.content: Make a self-introduction poster and present "My name is ___, I am ___ years old, I like ___"
en.tips: Practice with a partner once before presenting. Display in classroom afterwards.

ko.name: Class Interview
ko.content: 짝꿍 인터뷰 후 친구 소개 "This is ___, she/he likes ___".
ko.tips: "Can I ask you a question?" 질문 공식 먼저 연습. 마이크 소품이 자신감 UP.

en.name: Class Interview
en.content: Interview a partner then introduce them "This is ___, she/he likes ___".
en.tips: First practice "Can I ask you a question?" formula. Microphone prop boosts confidence.

ko.name: Shape Bingo
ko.content: 도형 빙고 + "I have a circle! Bingo!"
ko.tips: 빙고 전 모든 도형 한 번씩 복습. 줄 완성 시 "Bingo!" 외치게 하기.

en.name: Shape Bingo
en.content: Shape bingo + "I have a circle! Bingo!"
en.tips: Review all shapes once before bingo. Shout "Bingo!" when a line is complete.

ko.name: Shape Robot Build
ko.content: 도형 스티커로 로봇 만들고 "My robot has 3 squares" 발표.
ko.tips: 발표 시 "How many?" 물어보기. 짝꿍 로봇과 비교 "Mine is bigger!"

en.name: Shape Robot Build
en.content: Build a robot with shape stickers and present "My robot has 3 squares"
en.tips: Ask "How many?" during presentation. Compare with partner's robot "Mine is bigger!"

ko.name: Family Puppet Show
ko.content: 손가락 인형으로 가족 소개 + 짧은 대화.
ko.tips: 대화 스크립트 간단히 제공. 연습 2회 후 친구에게 발표.

en.name: Family Puppet Show
en.content: Introduce family with finger puppets + short dialogue.
en.tips: Provide simple dialogue script. Practice twice then present to classmates.

ko.name: Family Survey
ko.content: "How many people are in your family?" 조사 후 그래프 완성.
ko.tips: 결과 보며 "Most friends have 4 people!" 문장 함께 만들기.

en.name: Family Survey
en.content: "How many people are in your family?" survey then complete a graph.
en.tips: Looking at results, create a sentence together "Most friends have 4 people!"

ko.name: Weather Wheel & Reporter
ko.content: 날씨 휠 돌리고 "Today it is sunny and warm!" 날씨 리포터 역할.
ko.tips: 마이크 소품 추가. 매주 담당자 바꾸어 리포터 경험 골고루.

en.name: Weather Wheel & Reporter
en.content: Spin weather wheel and report "Today it is sunny and warm!" as weather reporter.
en.tips: Add microphone prop. Rotate reporter role each week for equal experience.

ko.name: Dress the Bear
ko.content: 날씨 카드 뽑고 곰 인형에 맞는 옷 입히기 + 이유 말하기.
ko.tips: "Why?"를 항상 물어보기. "Because it's cold!" 이유 문장 연습.

en.name: Dress the Bear
en.content: Draw a weather card and dress the bear correctly + explain why.
en.tips: Always ask "Why?" Practice reason sentences "Because it's cold!"

ko.name: Mystery Bag (Food)
ko.content: 만지고 "It is soft / round / bumpy" 묘사 후 맞히기.
ko.tips: 3개 이상 묘사 단어 말한 후 공개. 틀려도 묘사 잘 했으면 칭찬.

en.name: Mystery Bag (Food)
en.content: Feel and describe "It is soft / round / bumpy" then guess what it is.
en.tips: Say 3+ descriptive words before revealing. Praise good description even if guess is wrong.

ko.name: I Like / I Don't Like Graph
ko.content: 음식 그림 보고 투표 + "Most friends like ___" 결과 말하기.
ko.tips: 결과 분석 시 "Why do you like it?" 질문으로 이유 말하기 연습.

en.name: I Like / I Don't Like Graph
en.content: Vote on food pictures + say "Most friends like ___" for results.
en.tips: During results analysis, ask "Why do you like it?" to practice giving reasons.

ko.name: Action Verb Charades
ko.content: 동사 카드 뽑아 행동하고 팀이 맞히기.
ko.tips: 팀 나눠 점수제로 운영. 맞힌 팀은 동사로 문장 만들기 추가.

en.name: Action Verb Charades
en.content: Draw a verb card, act it out, team guesses.
en.tips: Run as teams with points. Winning team makes sentences with the verb as a bonus.

ko.name: "I Can!" Book
ko.content: "I can jump / swim / sing" 문장 완성 + 미니북 발표.
ko.tips: 완성 후 친구와 교환해서 읽어보기. "Can you ___?" 질문 연습.

en.name: "I Can!" Book
en.content: Complete "I can jump / swim / sing" sentences + mini-book presentation.
en.tips: After completing, exchange and read each other's books. Practice "Can you ___?"

ko.name: Where Is It? Game
ko.content: 물건 숨기고 "It's under the chair / in the box!" 전치사 말하기.
ko.tips: 선생님이 먼저 숨기고 아이들이 묻기. 역할 바꿔 아이가 숨기기.

en.name: Where Is It? Game
en.content: Hide an object and say "It's under the chair / in the box!" preposition practice.
en.tips: Teacher hides first, children ask. Then switch roles — children hide.

ko.name: Classroom Map
ko.content: 교실 지도 그리고 물건 위치 영어로 라벨 붙이기.
ko.tips: 완성 후 "The book is on the shelf" 문장으로 설명하게 하기.

en.name: Classroom Map
en.content: Draw a classroom map and label object locations in English.
en.tips: After completing, explain with "The book is on the shelf" sentences.

ko.name: Halloween Role Play
ko.content: Trick or Treat 상황극 "What do you want?" "I want candy!"
ko.tips: 스크립트 2-3회 연습 후 자유롭게. 의상 있으면 더욱 효과적.

en.name: Halloween Role Play
en.content: Trick or Treat skit "What do you want?" "I want candy!"
en.tips: Practice script 2–3 times then freestyle. Costumes make it even more effective.

ko.name: Opposites Tug of War
ko.content: big/small, fast/slow 팀 나눠 개념 몸으로 표현 + 플래시카드 매칭.
ko.tips: 카드 보여주며 "What's the opposite?" 빠르게 답하기. 박자감 있게 진행.

en.name: Opposites Tug of War
en.content: Teams for big/small, fast/slow express concepts physically + flashcard matching.
en.tips: Show card and quickly answer "What's the opposite?" Keep it rhythmic.

ko.name: Community Helpers Role Play
ko.content: 직업 의상 입고 역할극 "I am a doctor. Are you sick?"
ko.tips: 2인 1조 대화. 관객이 "What is your job?" 질문하기.

en.name: Community Helpers Role Play
en.content: Wear job costumes and role-play "I am a doctor. Are you sick?"
en.tips: Pairs dialogue. Audience asks "What is your job?"

ko.name: Thankful Tree
ko.content: "I am thankful for my ___" 문장 나뭇잎에 쓰고 트리 완성.
ko.tips: 쓰기 어려운 아이는 그림으로 OK. 발표 후 박수. 학부모 사진 공유.

en.name: Thankful Tree
en.content: Write "I am thankful for my ___" on leaf paper and complete the tree.
en.tips: Drawing is OK for those who can't write yet. Applause after presenting. Share photos with parents.

ko.name: Christmas Wish List Letter
ko.content: 산타에게 "I want a ___ because ___" 편지 쓰기.
ko.tips: because 이유 말하기 필수. 완성 후 크게 읽어보기.

en.name: Christmas Wish List Letter
en.content: Write to Santa "I want a ___ because ___"
en.tips: Must include because + reason. Read aloud after completing.

ko.name: Mini Performance
ko.content: 1년 배운 노래+챈트+역할극 미니 발표회.
ko.tips: 2주 전부터 파트 나누기. 학부모 초대 또는 영상 촬영 공유.

en.name: Mini Performance
en.content: Mini showcase of songs + chants + role-plays learned throughout the year.
en.tips: Divide parts 2 weeks in advance. Invite parents or record and share video.

ko.name: Show & Tell
ko.content: 집에서 좋아하는 물건 가져와 3문장 이상 소개.
ko.tips: 발표 전날 문장 연습 숙제 내주기. 청중은 질문 1개씩 하기.

en.name: Show & Tell
en.content: Bring a favorite item from home and introduce it in 3+ sentences.
en.tips: Give homework to practice sentences the night before. Audience asks one question each.

ko.name: Alphabet Phonics Bingo
ko.content: 알파벳 소리 듣고 빙고 + "B says /b/! Bingo!"
ko.tips: 소리만 듣고 맞히기 → 단어 듣고 맞히기 순서로 난이도 높이기.

en.name: Alphabet Phonics Bingo
en.content: Listen to letter sounds and play bingo + "B says /b/! Bingo!"
en.tips: First match by sound only → then match by word. Gradually increase difficulty.

ko.name: Story Retelling
ko.content: 그림책 읽고 순서 카드 배열 + 한 문장씩 말하기.
ko.tips: 추천: Brown Bear / Very Hungry Caterpillar. 순서 배열 후 역할 나눠 발표.

en.name: Story Retelling
en.content: Read a picture book, arrange sequence cards + say one sentence each.
en.tips: Recommended: Brown Bear / Very Hungry Caterpillar. Divide roles after arranging sequence.

ko.name: "I Can Now!" Presentation
ko.content: 1년간 배운 것 발표 + 친구에게 메시지 카드.
ko.tips: 포트폴리오 함께 넘기며 성장 확인. "I'm proud of you!" 선생님이 한 명씩 안아주기.

en.name: "I Can Now!" Presentation
en.content: Present what was learned during the year + message cards to friends.
en.tips: Browse portfolio together to confirm growth. "I'm proud of you!" Teacher hugs each child individually.

en.title: Age 7 Circle Time Activities (5–6 years / 24 activities)

ko.name: Me in a Bag
ko.content: 종이봉투에 자신을 나타내는 물건 3개 넣어 "This represents me because..." 발표.
ko.tips: 발표 후 "What do you have in common?" 친구와 비교. 공동점 찾기.

en.name: Me in a Bag
en.content: Put 3 objects that represent you in a paper bag and present "This represents me because..."
en.tips: After presenting, find commonalities "What do you have in common?" with friends.

ko.name: Question of the Day
ko.content: 칠판 질문("What is your favorite season?")에 답하고 이유 2문장 말하기.
ko.tips: 답 먼저 쓰고 발표. "I like ___ because ___ and ___." 구조 안내.

en.name: Question of the Day
en.content: Answer a board question ("What is your favorite season?") and give 2 reasons.
en.tips: Write answer first then present. Guide "I like ___ because ___ and ___." structure.

ko.name: Compound Word Builder
ko.content: 단어 카드 2장 합쳐 합성어 만들기 (sun+flower=sunflower).
ko.tips: 칠판에 붙이며 다 같이 소리내어 읽기. 새 합성어 발견하면 보너스 점수.

en.name: Compound Word Builder
en.content: Combine 2 word cards to make compound words (sun+flower=sunflower).
en.tips: Post on board and read aloud together. Bonus points for discovering new compound words.

ko.name: Adjective Describing Game
ko.content: 물건 보여주며 형용사 3개 이상 말하기. "It is big, round, and red!"
ko.tips: "Can you think of more?" 도전. 형용사 많이 말한 사람이 다음 물건 선택.

en.name: Adjective Describing Game
en.content: Show an object and say 3+ adjectives. "It is big, round, and red!"
en.tips: Challenge "Can you think of more?" Most adjectives gets to pick the next object.

ko.name: Rhyming Word Chain
ko.content: 공 굴리며 라임 단어 연결하기 (cat-bat-hat-mat).
ko.tips: 막히면 힌트 카드 활용. 체인 길이 기록 도전 "Can we beat our record?"

en.name: Rhyming Word Chain
en.content: Roll a ball and connect rhyming words (cat-bat-hat-mat).
en.tips: Use hint cards if stuck. Record chain length "Can we beat our record?"

ko.name: Emotion Scenario Cards
ko.content: 상황 카드 뽑아 감정 말하기 "If I lose my toy, I feel ___. I can ___."
ko.tips: 해결책도 함께 말하기. "What can you do?" 공감+해결 사고력 키우기.

en.name: Emotion Scenario Cards
en.content: Draw a situation card and express emotion "If I lose my toy, I feel ___. I can ___."
en.tips: Also say solutions "What can you do?" Build empathy + problem-solving thinking.

ko.name: Weather + Temperature Chart
ko.content: 날씨와 온도 기록 + "It's hotter than yesterday!" 비교 문장 말하기.
ko.tips: 한 달치 기록 후 "Which week was the coldest?" 분석하기.

en.name: Weather + Temperature Chart
en.content: Record weather and temperature + say comparison sentences "It's hotter than yesterday!"
en.tips: After a month of records, analyze "Which week was the coldest?"

ko.name: Preposition Map Challenge
ko.content: 교실 약도에 물건 위치 표시 + "The ___ is between ___ and ___" 설명.
ko.tips: 파트너와 서로 설명하며 맞추기. between / next to / across from 집중.

en.name: Preposition Map Challenge
en.content: Mark object locations on a classroom map + explain "The ___ is between ___ and ___"
en.tips: Partners explain and verify each other. Focus on between / next to / across from.

ko.name: Food Chain Sequencing
ko.content: 먹이사슬 카드 순서대로 배열 + "The ___ eats the ___." 문장 말하기.
ko.tips: "What would happen if...?" 가정 질문으로 사고 확장.

en.name: Food Chain Sequencing
en.content: Arrange food chain cards in order + say "The ___ eats the ___."
en.tips: Expand thinking with "What would happen if...?" hypothetical questions.

ko.name: Opinion Poll & Graph
ko.content: "What is your favorite summer activity?" 설문 + 그래프 완성 + 발표.
ko.tips: 결과 발표 시 "Most of us like..." "Fewer friends like..." 비교 문장 연습.

en.name: Opinion Poll & Graph
en.content: "What is your favorite summer activity?" survey + complete graph + present.
en.tips: Practice "Most of us like..." "Fewer friends like..." comparison sentences during results.

ko.name: Story Spine
ko.content: "Once upon a time... Every day... Until one day... Finally..." 구조로 이야기 만들기.
ko.tips: 그룹당 1편. 완성 후 발표. 가장 창의적인 팀에게 박수.

en.name: Story Spine
en.content: Create a story using "Once upon a time... Every day... Until one day... Finally..." structure.
en.tips: One story per group. Present after completing. Applause for most creative team.

ko.name: Debate Circle (Simple)
ko.content: "Dogs or cats? Summer or winter?" 팀 나눠 이유 말하기.
ko.tips: "I think ___ because ___." 구조 사용. 상대방 의견 "I understand, but..." 반박 연습.

en.name: Debate Circle (Simple)
en.content: "Dogs or cats? Summer or winter?" Teams give reasons.
en.tips: Use "I think ___ because ___." structure. Practice rebuttal "I understand, but..."

ko.name: Synonym Swap
ko.content: 단어 카드 뽑아 동의어 말하기 (big→large→huge).
ko.tips: 난이도: 쉬운 단어 → 감정 단어 → 동작 단어. 사전 보여주며 흥미 유도.

en.name: Synonym Swap
en.content: Draw word card and say synonyms (big→large→huge).
en.tips: Difficulty levels: easy words → emotion words → action words. Show dictionary to spark interest.

ko.name: News Reporter
ko.content: 학교 소식이나 간단한 사건 영어로 리포팅. "Today at our school..."
ko.tips: 전날 주제 미리 알려주기. 카메라 앞에서 찍으면 동기 부여 UP.

en.name: News Reporter
en.content: Report school news or simple events in English. "Today at our school..."
en.tips: Share topic the day before. Filming on camera boosts motivation significantly.

ko.name: Spooky Story Circle
ko.content: 공 전달하며 이야기 이어가기 "One dark night..." 협동 스토리텔링.
ko.tips: "Then suddenly..." "All of a sudden..." 전환 표현 가르쳐 주기.

en.name: Spooky Story Circle
en.content: Pass a ball and continue a story "One dark night..." Collaborative storytelling.
en.tips: Teach transition expressions "Then suddenly..." "All of a sudden..."

ko.name: Would You Rather?
ko.content: "Would you rather fly or be invisible?" 골라 이유 말하기.
ko.tips: "I would rather ___ because ___." 구조 사용. 두 번 이상 이유 말하기 도전.

en.name: Would You Rather?
en.content: "Would you rather fly or be invisible?" Choose and explain why.
en.tips: Use "I would rather ___ because ___." structure. Challenge to give 2+ reasons.

ko.name: Problem Solving Scenarios
ko.content: 상황 카드(친구와 싸움, 물건 잃어버림) 뽑아 해결책 토론.
ko.tips: "First I would... Then I would..." 순서 있는 해결책 말하기.

en.name: Problem Solving Scenarios
en.content: Draw situation cards (fight with friend, lost belongings) and discuss solutions.
en.tips: Use "First I would... Then I would..." structured solution format.

ko.name: Gratitude Letter Reading
ko.content: 감사 편지 써서 친구 앞에서 낭독 "Dear ___, I am thankful for you because..."
ko.tips: 낭독 전 연습 1회. 낭독 후 받는 친구 반응 "Thank you! I feel ___" 유도.

en.name: Gratitude Letter Reading
en.content: Write a thank-you letter and read aloud "Dear ___, I am thankful for you because..."
en.tips: Practice once before reading aloud. After reading, prompt recipient "Thank you! I feel ___"

ko.name: My Dream Job Presentation
ko.content: "I want to be a ___ because ___. I will ___" 3문장 발표.
ko.tips: 그림+문장 미니 포스터로 발표. 질문 1개씩 받기.

en.name: My Dream Job Presentation
en.content: "I want to be a ___ because ___. I will ___" 3-sentence presentation.
en.tips: Mini poster with drawing + sentences. Receive one question from audience each.

ko.name: Year-End Talk Show
ko.content: 사회자+게스트 역할로 1년 인터뷰. "What was your favorite activity?"
ko.tips: 사회자 역할 돌아가며. 과장된 리액션 유도. 영상 촬영 후 공유.

en.name: Year-End Talk Show
en.content: Host + guest roles for year-end interview. "What was your favorite activity?"
en.tips: Rotate host role. Encourage exaggerated reactions. Record video and share.

ko.name: Book Talk
ko.content: 좋아하는 책 30초 소개 "This book is about... I liked it because..."
ko.tips: 완벽하지 않아도 OK. "Any questions?" 청중 질문 1개 연습.

en.name: Book Talk
en.content: 30-second introduction of a favorite book "This book is about... I liked it because..."
en.tips: Imperfection is OK. Practice "Any questions?" Audience asks one question each.

ko.name: Rhyme & Riddle Time
ko.content: 수수께끼 내고 맞히기 "I am round. I am orange. You eat me. What am I?"
ko.tips: 아이가 직접 수수께끼 만들기 도전. 힌트 3개 구조 가르쳐 주기.

en.name: Rhyme & Riddle Time
en.content: Give and guess riddles "I am round. I am orange. You eat me. What am I?"
en.tips: Challenge children to create their own riddles. Teach the 3-hint structure.

ko.name: Collaborative Story Book
ko.content: 그룹별 이야기 한 페이지씩 써서 클래스 책 완성.
ko.tips: 그림+문장 함께. 완성 후 전체 낭독. 학교 도서관에 비치.

en.name: Collaborative Story Book
en.content: Each group writes one page to complete a class book.
en.tips: Drawing + sentences together. Read aloud when complete. Display in school library.

ko.name: My Growth Portfolio Share
ko.content: 1년 작품 포트폴리오 발표 "I improved in... I am proud of..."
ko.tips: "Before and after" 비교. 성장에 집중한 칭찬. 학부모 초대 공유 가능.

en.name: My Growth Portfolio Share
en.content: Present 1-year portfolio "I improved in... I am proud of..."
en.tips: Compare "Before and after". Praise focused on growth. Parents can be invited to share.
